mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request(from_user, to_user, status) VALUES(#{from}, #{to}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_friend WHERE (user_id = #{from} AND friend_id = #{to}) OR (user_id = #{to} AND friend_id = #{from})

SELECT fr.from_user AS fromUser, fr.to_user AS toUser, fr.status, u.avatar, fr.create_time AS createTime FROM friend_request fr LEFT JOIN chat_user u ON fr.from_user = u.user_id WHERE fr.to_user = #{userId} AND fr.status = 'pending' ORDER BY fr.create_time DESC
